q: My device cannot connect to WiFi. What should I do?
a:
Please follow the steps below in order:
1. Power on the base station and open the BFOUR+ app, and place the base station close to your phone.
2. Open the app and tap "Add Device" on the home screen.
3. Select your product model from the list.
4. On the search page, tap the device that matches your model name (BF-70 or BF-80).
5. Tap "Refresh".
6. Select the WiFi network you want to connect to and enter the password.

Once you have completed the above steps, your device should be able to connect normally.

If you are still unable to connect, please submit your issue through the Problem Feedback feature in the app, along with a screenshot of your order, and we will process it as soon as possible.

q: My thermometer shows an "Out of Range" alert. What causes this and what should I do?
a:
The "Out of Range" alert typically indicates that the signal connection between the probe and the receiver has been interrupted. Please follow the steps below to troubleshoot:

1. Check the probe connection and charging
Please make sure the probe is fully charged:
(1) BF-30 / BF-40: Charge on the base station for 2–3 minutes
(2) BF-70 / BF-80: Charge on the base station for 10–15 minutes
If the issue persists after charging, please try re-pairing / re-adding the probe with the receiver.

2. Check the distance and signal interference
(1) During use, please ensure the receiver is kept as close to the probe as possible.
(2) Check for signal obstructions such as thick cookware and other electronic devices.
(3) You may also try placing the receiver near the front or side of the oven for better signal reception.

3. Check the usage environment and temperature limits
(1) Food temperature should be kept within the range of -10°C ~ 100°C
(2) Ambient temperature should be kept within the range of 0°C ~ 400°C

Please note: If the internal temperature of the meat exceeds the recommended safe value, the system may also trigger an alert.

4. On-site test
When the "Out of Range" alert appears, please try moving the receiver closer to the probe and check whether the signal recovers.

If the issue persists after following the above steps, please submit your issue through the Problem Feedback feature in the app, along with a screenshot of your order, and we will process it as soon as possible.

Thank you for your cooperation!

q: My thermometer frequently disconnects and the signal is unstable. What should I do?
a:
Please follow the steps below to troubleshoot:

1. Restart the device: Power off and restart the base station, and place the probe back into the base station then take it out again to allow the device to re-pair and reconnect.
2. Reduce the distance: Place the base station close to the probe to ensure they are within the effective Bluetooth transmission range, and minimize obstacles in between.
3. Avoid signal interference: Ensure the base station is kept away from other Bluetooth devices, Wi-Fi routers, or microwave ovens.
4. Check battery level: Ensure both the probe and the base station have sufficient battery power.

If the issue persists after following the above steps, please submit your issue through the Problem Feedback feature in the app, along with a screenshot of your order, and we will process it as soon as possible.

q: After connecting, my device does not display the ambient temperature. What causes this and what should I do?
a:
Please follow the steps below to confirm:

1. Check the probe insertion method
Please insert the probe into the thickest part of the meat, and make sure all safety lines on the probe are fully submerged into the meat.

2. Confirm the display interface
After proper placement, the base station and the app interface should display both "Internal Temperature" and "Ambient Temperature" simultaneously.

3. Check the Bluetooth connection status
(1) Please confirm whether the connection between the base station and the probe is stable.
(2) Try moving the base station closer to the probe.
(3) Or place the probe back into the base station, then take it out again to re-pair.

4. Ambient temperature sensor notes
(1) The measuring range of the ambient temperature is 20–400°C. It will not display below 20°C.
(2) The ambient temperature sensor is embedded near the top of the probe's ceramic handle.

5. Common causes of abnormal temperature display
(1) It takes longer for heat to transfer through the ceramic handle to the sensor.
(2) Cold meat can conduct low temperature through the stainless steel probe to the sensor, affecting the initial reading.
This is a normal phenomenon. During low-temperature cooking, the ambient temperature reading will gradually become accurate as cooking time extends.

If the issue persists after following the above steps, please submit your issue through the Problem Feedback feature in the app, along with a screenshot of your order, and we will process it as soon as possible.

Thank you for your cooperation and understanding!

q: My thermometer readings are inaccurate and differ from those of my instant-read thermometer. What should I do?
a:
Our wireless probe is specifically designed for low-power long-term monitoring. Temperature readings are taken every 2 seconds and updated via Bluetooth. Its heating response speed cannot be directly compared to that of a plug-and-play instant-read thermometer, and the time required to reach thermal equilibrium is much slower. However, if you continuously monitor the temperature during cooking, its readings are accurate and reliable.

We recommend using the ice water calibration method for testing and verification:
1. Fill a glass with ice cubes.
2. Add cold water and stir for about 15 seconds.
3. Fully submerge the probe in the center of the ice water.
4. Let it sit for 15 seconds, then read the value.

Under normal conditions, the reading in the ice water mixture should be close to 0°C.
If the deviation is significant, please submit your issue through the Problem Feedback feature in the app, along with a screenshot of your order, and we will process it as soon as possible.

q: I feel that the battery life of my thermometer is not long enough. What should I do?
a:
Please first confirm the following:

1. Ensure both devices are fully charged
BF-30 / BF-40: Place the probe on the base station and charge for 3–5 minutes.
BF-70 / BF-80: Place the probe on the base station and charge for 10–15 minutes.

2. Notes on the battery indicator
The battery percentage displayed on the base station is not absolutely accurate. Occasionally, it may show only one bar of battery remaining, but the device can still function normally for a considerable period.

3. Normal battery life (when fully charged)
BF-30 / BF-40: Probe battery life 40 hours, base station battery life 90 hours
BF-70 / BF-80: Probe battery life 33 hours, base station battery life 24 hours

4. Battery specifications
BF-30 / BF-40: 500mAh, 3.7V
BF-70 / BF-80: 2600mAh, 3.7V

If the battery life is still insufficient, please submit your issue through the Problem Feedback feature in the app, along with a screenshot of your order, and we will process it as soon as possible.
